status: shadow / validation only; no production NasDecode score consumes this output

architecture.score: 60% multi-horizon residual strength + 15% persistence + 25% internal semiconductor confirmation
architecture.normalization: Each historical horizon uses only residuals available before that horizon as its baseline. Score remains unpublished during warm-up until all four horizons and confirmation are available.
architecture.persistence: Positive Phase 2 residual share over last 10 model sessions.
architecture.confirmation: 35% basket positive breadth + 35% basket outperform-QQQ breadth + 20% SOXX/QQQ RS + 10% SMH/QQQ RS.
architecture.sensitivities: Published as diagnostics only in v1.0; they do not receive score points.
architecture.hype: Hype Pressure remains separate context until Model B has sufficient prospective point-in-time history.
